theme: CS4-3/CS4-4 tuple patterns and wrapper-lambda kinds
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a tuple pattern on a subject whose type is already known is type-checked - a tuple of another length or a non-tuple subject is E0102 and the components take the element types; untyped lambda params, generics and the unit pattern () are unchanged. A wrapper lambda's call nested in another call's arguments or in a method receiver now derives its param kind in run order, so a kind mismatch that panicked at run is E0102 at check; a call after a sibling argument's call or an earlier statement's call derives nothing. New refusals are dead tuple arms on non-tuple subjects (t_iflet, t_mixed_arity, t_struct_subj). The 712 tracked .ax files check with identical diagnostics before and after.
